title: Keep a task-sync push start's dispatch when the process stops after its acknowledgement and before the push
outcome: Keep a task-sync push start's dispatch when the process stops after its acknowledgement and before the push
acceptance: A PushStarted whose committing process stops after the private witness acknowledged it but before its caller pushed is still pushed exactly once by a later exact retry or step, proven by a test that kills or fails the process in that window on the original and the resolved-retry paths

A second push is never sent for a start whose push already landed, including after a power loss that rolls the private witness back on Windows, or the case is documented as an accepted limitation with its consequence
